Talent0_2Ability.name: Condensed Starburst
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks. After combat, if possesses <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>, removes <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf> and gains <color=#F74848>3</color> AP and <buf ID=900138>[Temporary AP cap]</buf>, then triggers <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Condensed Starburst
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>, up to <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks. After combat, if possesses <color=#F74848>5</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>, removes <color=#F74848>5</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf> and gains <color=#F74848>3</color> AP and <buf ID=900138>[Temporary AP cap]</buf>, then triggers <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.
When attacking, additionally gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>. At the start of turn, if <buf ID=900133>[Condensed]</buf> AP recovery effect was triggered in previous turn, additionally gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

100001.name: Mobile Warfare 1
100001.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered. Unable to move before the attack, and this can be effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101702.name: Shatter Steel
101702.SpecificEffects: When attacking, increases DMG dealt to part with <color=#F74848>50%</color> HP or more by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

101703.name: Mirror Heart
101703.SpecificEffects: When attacked by melee or ranged weapons, if equipped with Alter-Blade in both hands and both hands are in tact, activates <buf ID=900136>[Insight]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2x</color> DMG. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

101704.name: Starfall Flash
101704.describe: Selects <color=#F74848>1</color> target (including flying target) within <color=#F74848>4</color> adjacent tiles and strikes with Alter-Blade, dealing <color=#F74848>1.2</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. After attacking, this unit will be positioned on a random unoccupied tile within <color=#F74848>1</color> ring around the target.

101705.name: Restoring Light
101705.SpecificEffects: When any arm is destroyed, up to <color=#F74848>1</color> arm can be restored with <color=#F74848>50%</color> max HP after combat. This effect has a <color=#F74848>3</color> turns CD.

101706.name: Skyfall Slash
101706.describe: Uses two Alter-Blades to attack all enemies within an <range type=2>L-shaped (3x1-tile)</range> or <color=#F74848>3</color> horizontal front tiles, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5</color> AOE DMG. Can enter <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> on each target individually.

101707.name: Combo Breaker
101707.SpecificEffects: At the start of turn, if there are <color=#F74848>3</color> or more enemies within <color=#F74848>3</color> adjacent tiles, gains <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>.

101708.name: Falling Starlight
101708.describe: Use two Alter-Blades to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2.4x</color> DMG. This attack prioritizes the body and grants <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=1017503>[Condensed I]</buf>.

100011.name: Mobile Warfare 2
100011.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

100021.name: Mobile Warfare 3
100021.SpecificEffects: Destroying the target can trigger <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>, allowing action with full movement distance.

100022.name: Power Innovation 2
100022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101531.name: Terminator 1
101531.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking with an Alter-Blade, if the part hit is below <color=#F74848>15%</color> HP, triggers the <buf ID=900109>[Execution]</buf> effect, directly destroying that part after combat.

100033.name: Mobile Warfare 4
100033.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

101534.name: Terminator 2
101534.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=1015311>[Terminator 1]</buf> part destruction effect threshold increased to <color=#F74848>25%</color> HP.

101535.name: Terminator 3
101535.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=900101>[Terminator]</buf> to destroy a part, negates the deduction of <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> or <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf> count and additionally restores <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

101536.name: Terminator 4
101536.SpecificEffects: When using an Alter-Blade to destroy parts other than the Body, inflicts <buf ID=900017>[Fixed DMG]</buf> on the Body equal to <color=#F74848>25%</color> of the destroyed part's Max HP.

101741.name: Twin Star Edge 1
101741.SpecificEffects: While possessing <buf ID=900133>[Condensed]</buf>, movement increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

100043.name: Power Innovation 3
100043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

101745.name: Twin Star Edge 3
101745.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900133>[Condensed]</buf> additionally increases critical hit chance by <color=#F74848>3%</color>.

101746.name: Twin Star Edge 5
101746.SpecificEffects: Talent effect increases to restoring <color=#F74848>5</color> AP and additionally grants <buf ID=1017466>[Starburst]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn.

hiddenSkills.name: Flash Strike
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses two Alter-Blades to attack a single target, dealing <color=#F74848>2×0.85</color> DMG.
